SharedLines.gas_description: Sealed gas line between gas stores and the machines they feed or fill. Lay it tile by tile on intact floor from port to port; every machine and store whose gas port it reaches joins the same line, and touching equipment joins without it. Shares a tile with other kinds of line. Holds no gas between transfers.
SharedLines.water_description: Sealed line for process water between water tanks and the machines that draw or make it. Lay it tile by tile on intact floor from port to port; every machine and tank whose water port it reaches joins the same line, and touching equipment joins without it. Process grade only: it never joins drinking water. Holds no water between transfers.

WaterTanks.description: A sealed {2} x {2} silo holding {1:F0} kg of process water in a {0:F0} kg housing. Fill it at a station under Bulk supplies, from a linked machine such as a T2 ice thaw unit, or from the ship's drinking-water tanks when Ship's Water is installed; send water back to its waste tanks for the Recycler. Machines reach it by touching it or along a process-water line to the port beside the middle of its left-hand side, and several can share it. Not a drinking-water tank. Damage traps the water in a catch chamber: repair, then recover it.
